_comment: Non-sensitive defaults only. Override secrets via environment variable: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection (see fishmmo-secrets.env or fish shell snippet).
_comment_allowed_hosts: Restricted to localhost for development. Change to the production domain (e.g., "play.fishmmo.com") in production — a wildcard "*" allows any host and is a security risk.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Set ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection env var with your PostgreSQL connection string. Example: Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=fishmmo;Username=...;Password=...
